messages:
mike_new: Hi all, new to Redwood. I followed the quickstart (node) and the text generate worked, but when I tried the embeddings example I get a 403: 'api_activation_required' with message 'enable_embeddings_api'.
julia_sdk: can you paste the exact request you used for embeddings? is this the client.embeddings call from the starter?
mike_new: minimal repro below:
```js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
await client.embeddings({ model: 'embed-small-1', input: 'hello' });
```
Error body: {"status":403, "error":"api_activation_required", "message":"enable_embeddings_api", "hint":"Visit org settings -> APIs to enable embeddings"}
frank_support: thanks for the report. context: we recently introduced per-api activation so org admins can opt into embeddings/vision features separately for compliance. the gating is intentional but the quickstart didn't surface it.
mike_new: surprised because text generation worked out of the box. the quickstart uses the same API key and I assumed all endpoints are available. can we make the SDK or quickstart clearer?
julia_sdk: agree. parity note: Python SDK already maps this to an OnboardingFeatureDisabledError with a docs link; Node currently returns raw body. that's a gap. i'll file DEVEX-1603 to map api_activation_required to a typed error and include a human-friendly hint and direct settings URL.
product: product note 1: we want per-api opt-ins, but the UX must make that clear during workspace setup. adding a CTA to onboarding that explains "Enable Embeddings / Vision APIs" and a one-click toggle.
mike_new: two asks: 1) can quickstart preflight check API availability so embeddings sample prints a clear message rather than raw 403? 2) is there a sandbox path to try embeddings without adding billing or toggling settings?
frank_support: for 2) we can issue a short-lived sandbox token for experimentation. for 1) yes 1 recommended preflight: GET /orgs/:id/features or GET /auth/whoami returns enabled_apis array. quickstart should check that before calling embeddings and print a friendly instruction: "Enable embeddings in org settings or request a sandbox token from support."
julia_sdk: will add a helper `client.ensureApiEnabled('embeddings')` to SDK examples and update the quickstart README. DEVEX-1603 will include the Node mapping + quickstart preflight change.
devex-bot: DEVEX-1603 created by julia_sdk at 2026-03-25T09:12:00Z (labels: sdk-parity, onboarding-improve).
mike_new: thanks. one more thing 1 the error hint text currently points to a generic docs page. can we make the SDK include a direct link to the org settings page (if org id present)? even a single click would help.
product: good idea. we can add a contextual link in the error payload when we detect the org id in the request. will sync with backend to include settings_url in the error JSON for feature gates.
julia_sdk: follow-up: i'll also add a short snippet in the starter that shows how to fall back to text generation if embeddings are disabled, with a clear log message. PR incoming later today.
frank_support: i'll update the KB and create a canned support response that includes steps for admins to enable embeddings and how to request a sandbox token.
mike_new: huge help, thanks everyone 1 saved me digging. will watch for the quickstart update. :rocket:
